maria: FYI ran a replay on last night's trace set (mixed-prod traces) and noticed ~12% tail-latency regression for continuous-batching after the new kernel-selector change :eyes:
kevin: Do you mean the selector that prefers fp16 kernels over mixed-int8? which model/config did you replay against?
maria: Yes — selector429 (fp16-prefer). Replay config: model=gptx-7b, seq_len=2048, token_budget=128, replay_id=replay-2026-03-18-01

maria: Config snippet we used:
```
selector: selector429
model: gptx-7b
seq_len: 2048
token_budget: 128
queue_policy: default
```

anita: What happened to KV warmup hit rates in the replay? that's often the culprit for kernel churn.
maria: kv warmup hit-rate dropped from 93% -> 71% in high-concurrency windows. Misses caused more kernel switches (fp16 <-> int8 runtime paths) and extra memcpy.
sasha: Sounds like queueing created many short-lived batches that forced kernel selection decisions mid-prefetch. We should try biasing queue-priors to favor established prefixes so KV warmup can complete.

kevin: Profiling snapshot (hot path):
```
[perf] kernel_switch_cost: 2.6ms avg per switch
[perf] memcpy_overhead: 1.1ms avg
batcher: avg formation 3.4ms, variance spikes on short requests
```
kevin: Continuous batching under selector429 has higher kernel_switch_count per request; that 2-3ms hits tail.

bench-bot: A/B harness finished: baseline (selector420) vs selector429+default-queue -> throughput +1% but p99 latency +12% (same traces). See /perf/ab/4820 for full CSV.

maria: Proposed next steps: run offline replay sweep for token_budget targets {64,128,256} and simulate prefetch KV warmup with a configurable prefetch_window (try 50ms/100ms). Also run A/B harness with queue_priors tuned to penalize kernel switches. Collect kernel_id and kernel_switch_count telemetry per request.

kevin: I'll spin up sims for token_budget sweep and an alternate queue-priors config that groups by prefix_length > 32 and age > 15ms to reduce thrash. ETA: end of day.

perf-ci: Job created -> 4821. Params: replay_id=replay-2026-03-18-01, token_budget_sweep=[64,128,256], queue_priors_experiment=group-by-prefix, prefetch_windows=[50,100]. Results will upload to /perf/replays/4821.csv when done.

anita: Also please add kernel selection telemetry flags: record kernel_id per segment, kernel_switch_count, kv_warmup_hit(bool), and batch_formation_time_ms. That will make the offline analysis easier.

maria: Agreed. Once results land, we should run the A/B eval harness with canary rollout (10%/90%) and compute token-level cost/latency breakdown. Drop the CSV into /perf/replays/ and ping this thread. :thumbsup:
